test_strategy: Adopt a hybrid testing approach covering backend services, data migration scripts, and API endpoints. Use Jest for unit and integration tests, Postman/Newman for API E2E validations, and custom parity and performance scripts for data validation. Focus on data correctness, dual-write consistency, CDC integrity, rollback reliability, and MongoDB performance targets. Implement continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and AWS ECS execution environments.

test_cases.title: Validate MongoDB schema structure supports country-specific subfields
test_cases.description: Ensure MongoDB document model correctly stores customer data including nested country fields without requiring schema migrations.
steps: Insert sample customer document with country-specific subfields
test_cases.expected_result: Document stored successfully with nested subfields supported without schema error

test_cases.title: Test CDC-based backfill process for data parity and completeness
test_cases.description: Verify CDC pipeline streams all PostgreSQL changes to MongoDB accurately ensuring zero data loss.
preconditions: Source PostgreSQL and target MongoDB collections connected
steps: Check it appears in MongoDB within expected delay
test_cases.expected_result: All PostgreSQL records and incremental changes are reflected in MongoDB with 100% parity

test_cases.title: Dual-write operation consistency across PostgreSQL and MongoDB
test_cases.description: Validate that customer data updates are consistently written to both databases during transitional phase.
steps: Verify data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB
test_cases.expected_result: Both databases contain identical customer data with no mismatched fields

test_cases.title: Record parity verification before final cutover
test_cases.description: Ensure validation script confirms all migrated records match PostgreSQL data before switching traffic fully to MongoDB.
steps: Check total records and mismatch count in response
test_cases.expected_result: Validation report shows zero mismatches and 'success' status

test_cases.title: MongoDB index performance validation
test_cases.description: Verify that indexed queries meet <50ms read latency at p95 under load.
preconditions: Indexes created on country and name fields
test_cases.expected_result: Query response latency is below 50ms for 95th percentile of requests

test_cases.title: Feature flag rollout control for gradual migration activation
test_cases.description: Validate toggling of feature flags progressively switches traffic from PostgreSQL to MongoDB without errors.
test_cases.expected_result: Traffic routing changes according to flag status with zero downtime

test_cases.title: Rollback mechanism operational verification
test_cases.description: Check rollback procedure correctly reverts system traffic to PostgreSQL in case of errors within one hour.
test_cases.expected_result: System redirects reads/writes to PostgreSQL within 1 hour, status 'success' returned

test_cases.title: Negative test - MongoDB write failure handling during dual-write
test_cases.description: Simulate MongoDB connection failure to ensure PostgreSQL writes still succeed and errors logged properly.
test_cases.expected_result: PostgreSQL record created successfully, MongoDB error logged, system continues without crash

test_cases.title: Negative test - Schema validation failure on invalid data
test_cases.description: Ensure invalid input data is rejected according to JSON schema validation rules.
steps: Send POST /api/customers with missing required fields
test_cases.expected_result: System returns 400 or validation error without data insertion

test_cases.title: Security test for improper access during migration
test_cases.description: Confirm RBAC and TLS configuration prevent unauthorized database access during migration period.
test_cases.expected_result: Connection denied and properly logged, no sensitive data exposed

test_data_requirements: Sample customer records for multiple countries (JP, EU, US)
Large dataset simulation (2M records) for performance testing
Invalid schema payloads for negative test scenarios
CDC simulation events for testing data stream
Feature flag configurations for staged rollout
automation_approach: Leverage Jest for unit and integration tests with coverage tracking, Newman for API E2E testing, and custom Node.js parity and performance scripts integrated into CI/CD. Automate migration validation and rollback scenarios using AWS ECS scheduled tasks. Continuous monitoring via CloudWatch integrated with GitHub Actions pipeline for nightly parity verification.
coverage_goals: 90% code coverage across services, 100% validation of migrated records for data parity, 95% API endpoint test coverage, all critical paths (dual-write, rollback, CDC, feature toggling) tested across environments including staging and production simulations.
